examples.text: Der neue Mitschüler ist eine Intelligenzbestie. (= Der neue Mitschüler ist sehr schlau)

examples.text: Der neue Nachbar ist vielleicht eine Intelligenzbestie …(= Der neue Nachbar hat sich gerade sehr dumm angestellt)

glosses: Someone possessing extraordinary intelligence or skill; especially somebody who has demonstrated this by a creative or original work in science, music, art, etc.

examples.text: She's a genius; she won a Nobel Prize at fifteen!
Marx stand höher, sah weiter, überblickte mehr und rascher als wir andern alle. Marx war ein Genie, wir andern höchstens Talente.

glosses: Extraordinary mental capacity.

examples.text: Excuse, therefore, the shortcomings of genius under the sudorific influence of the summer solstice; for be assured that the vertical sun, however it may dulcify and mature cherries, plums, and other fruitful ‘plumpitudes,’ is by no means favorable to the development of intellectual products.

In the old days, to my commonplace and unobserving mind, he gave no evidences of genius whatsoever. He never read me any of his manuscripts, […], and therefore my lack of detection of his promise may in some degree be pardoned.

glosses: Inspiration, a mental leap, an extraordinary creative process.

examples.text: a work of genius
to add a dash of cinnamon amid such umami was pure genius

glosses: The tutelary deity or spirit of a place or person.

examples.text: and the genius of the place: the growing enthusiasm for codified standards in the Army and Navy
We talk of genius still, but with thought how changed! The genius of Augustus was a tutelary demon, to be sworn by and to receive offerings on an altar as a deity.

An old sinner, in shape of a khansamah, is the genius of the place, and has rarely aught else to tempt the tired traveller with than a “sudden death”—a fowl caught running in the yard, and dished up forthwith; […]

glosses: Ingenious, brilliant, very clever, or original.

examples.text: What a genius idea!

We all know how genius “Kamp Krusty,” “A Streetcar Named Marge,” “Homer The Heretic,” “Itchy & Scratchy: The Movie” and “Mr. Plow” are, but even the relatively unheralded episodes offer wall-to-wall laughs and some of the smartest, darkest, and weirdest gags ever Trojan-horsed into a network cartoon with a massive family audience.
But Vahul was more genius than Rishi.
She said the writing for these products “is very genius” because it's carefully done.

glosses: The control center of the central nervous system of an animal located in the skull which is responsible for perception, cognition, attention, memory, emotion, and action.

The brain of a calf, sheep, and pig, young and served fresh, is reputedly erotic in its effects.

glosses: The control center of the central nervous system of an animal located in the skull which is responsible for perception, cognition, attention, memory, emotion, and action.

examples.text: The left brain, or that which supplies and animates the right side of the body, is the most active brain, as a general rule.

glosses: Mind.

examples.text: I have too much on my brain today.
